description: This file is a shell script that contains tests for git fetch functionality, including setup and verification of fetching from multiple remotes, handling errors, and configuration options.

methods.name: setup_repository
methods.description: Initializes a new git repository in a specified directory with an initial commit and a side branch.

methods.name: setup_test_clone
methods.description: Clones a repository and adds multiple remotes for testing.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the git commit timestamp to ensure unique commit times.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit in the current repository with a specified tag.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Asserts that the executed command fails.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that a file is empty.

methods.name: test_path_is_missing
methods.description: Checks that a specified path does not exist.

methods.name: test_line_count
methods.description: Counts the number of lines in the input stream.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for a pattern within logs or output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares the contents of two files or streams for equality.
